Apple iOS 7 website, 2013

Apple’s launch page for iOS 7: very thin type on white and the new flat icons, under the old glossy navigation bar.

Source
apple.com, iOS 7 page (archived copy)
Creator
Apple
Made
2013
Style
Flat design (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Airy, clean, light
Evidence
Captured with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 from the Wayback Machine copy of 20 September 2013, and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens. Nothing covers the page. The headlines are images, so their weight is not measured.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • A gray navigation bar with a top highlight, vertical dividers, and a rounded search field runs across the top.
  • Under a thin gray rule, “iOS 7” and the line “The mobile OS from a whole new perspective.” are set in very thin, large dark gray type, centered on white.
  • A white iPhone lies at an angle below. Its screen shows the iOS 7 home screen: rounded-square icons in bright colors, with simple glyphs and soft gradients, on a dark blue starry wallpaper.

Why it belongs

Measured: 7% of screenshot pixels are saturated, and 65% of boxes have a 1 px border, so the capture fails the color and border ranges. The glossy navigation bar is an image the extractor cannot see.

The page shows the flat turn in type and icons before Apple removed the gloss from its site navigation; NN/g dates Apple’s fully flat navigation to 2015 (NN/g).

Borrow

Use a very thin weight at a very large size for a single headline on white, and let the colored content carry the color.
